notes: Reviewed change request 2026-07-28-01-expander-icon-and-positions.md with world-review subagent. The agent approved with modifications. Key findings: (1) current left sidebar toggle icon logic is inverted — chevron_right shown when open, chevron_left when closed, both backwards; (2) mobile hamburger relocation to bottom as FAB is a standard pattern (Material Design 3, iOS); (3) desktop floating edge chevrons are recognized in VS Code, Figma, Notion, Linear; (4) recommended mobile icon: upward chevron (keyboard_arrow_up or expand_less) to couple with bottom-sheet animation; (5) recommended desktop icon container: rounded circle/pill with solid background, 40x40px minimum, hover states, z-index ~200; (6) accessibility requirements: aria-expanded, aria-controls, dynamic aria-label reflecting current action, Enter/Space operability, optional focus transfer to first interactive element on expand. Updated change request document with all recommendations organized under each section plus a dedicated Accessibility Requirements section.
